Taxonomic distance between a hit and the sample, in rank steps

Source: R/taxonomy_ranks.R
rank_distance.Rd

0 = same species, 1 = same genus, 2 = family, 3 = order, 4 = class, 5 = phylum, 6 = kingdom, 7 = no shared taxon at any rank.

Usage

rank_distance(hit_taxids, sample_taxids)

Arguments

hit_taxids, sample_taxids

Rank-aligned taxid vectors from parse_rank_taxids(), or ";"-joined taxid strings.

Value

integer in 0..7.

Details

Distance is deliberately NOT a measure of sequence divergence. A large distance on its own is the normal state for an under-represented taxon and must never be read as contamination; it only becomes evidence when paired with an implausibly high percent identity (see the screen envelope).
